mapper.select: select count(*) as total_count, SUM(IF(specialty = '放射影像', 1, 0)) AS radiology_imaging, SUM(IF(specialty = '放射治疗', 1, 0)) AS radiation_therapy, SUM(IF(specialty = '核医学', 1, 0)) AS nuclear_medicine, SUM(IF(specialty = '卫生管理', 1, 0)) AS health_management, SUM(IF(specialty = '医学设备与安全防护', 1, 0)) AS medical_equipment_safety, SUM(IF(specialty = '医学智能工程', 1, 0)) AS medical_intelligent_engineering FROM biz_expert_ext where deleted = 0 and specialty IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS petCtScanner, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linearAccelerator, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus FROM biz_equipment_manufacturer WHERE deleted = 0
and YEAR(a.create_time) = #{req.year}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪', 1, 0)), 0) AS petCtScanner, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '直线加速器', 1, 0)), 0) AS linearAccelerator, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪', 1, 0)), 0) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '首次配置的大型医疗器械', 1, 0)), 0) AS firstTimeLargeMedicalDevice, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '高端放射治疗类设备', 1, 0)), 0) AS highEndRtEquipment, IFNULL(SUM(IF(license_device_name = '重离子质子放射治疗系统', 1, 0)), 0) AS heavyIonProtonRtSystem FROM biz_class_a_equipment WHERE deleted = 0
AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year}

select count(a.id) as total, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS petCtScanner, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '直线加速器' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS linearAccelerator, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus from biz_institution_ext a left join biz_application b on a.dept_id = b.institution_id where b.app_status = 5
select b.region as region, count(a.id) as total from biz_application a left join biz_institution_ext b on a.institution_id = b.dept_id where a.deleted = 0 and b.deleted = 0

WITH yearly_counts AS ( SELECT YEAR(create_time) AS "year", COUNT(*) AS yearly_count FROM biz_license_original WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY YEAR(create_time) ), yearly_growth AS ( SELECT "year", yearly_count, LAG(yearly_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY "year") AS prev_year_count FROM yearly_counts ) SELECT "year", yearly_count AS inc_count, prev_year_count AS prev_count, ROUND( CASE WHEN prev_year_count IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN prev_year_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (yearly_count - prev_year_count) * 100.0 / prev_year_count END, 2 ) AS yoy_rate FROM yearly_growth ORDER BY "year"
SELECT ladder_config_model AS model, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS percentage FROM biz_license_original WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ladder_config_model
